figure.note: four gas-preparation set-ups labelled A-D (pasted scan, no text labels on the apparatus). Each: a round-bottom flask with dark liquid, held by a clamp on a retort stand on a base board, a thistle funnel through the stopper, and a bent delivery tube to a gas jar. A: thistle funnel stem and delivery tube both reach down into the liquid; delivery tube runs into an upright open gas jar, ending near its bottom. B: thistle funnel stem and delivery tube both end above the liquid; delivery tube into an upright gas jar, ending near its bottom. C: thistle funnel stem ends above the liquid; delivery tube leaves the flask, runs down, along the base and up into a gas jar held by a second clamp stand (tube enters from below, jar mouth at the top). D: thistle funnel stem dips into the liquid, delivery tube ends above the liquid; delivery tube into an upright gas jar, ending near its bottom. Tube ends are small at this resolution: check against the crop.
